fields.statement: QA at 3bda3170 with a -trimpath build, in a scratch repo with a bare origin and a fake gh: on a pushed change set branch behind a main that had landed and rendered other change sets, ran rhiza ship rebase with SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA and SHIP_HEAD_BUILD naming a logging build script. Clean merge: the build ran after the merge (its tree held main's new change set log), then render --json ran through SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA, the merged head was pushed and rhiza check printed ok. Rendered-only conflict (branch rewrote rendered/index.md): the build ran during the merge (MERGE_HEAD set, main's logs present) before the settling render, and again before the final render; Settled 1 rendered file, pushed, check ok. Failing SHIP_HEAD_BUILD: exit 1 with the build's stderr, the branch and origin's branch kept their head, no merge left in progress, clean tree. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipRebase|TestSessionRun|TestShipLand' passes (only the known ~/code .rhiza-root usage guard trips). But TestScripts/ship-land-branch-build now FAILS: it still expects ship land to go build rhiza when go.mod names Rhiza's module, the isRhizaRepo path this change set removed.

QA at 3bda3170: rhiza ship rebase run by hand with a workflow-style env (SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA, SHIP_HEAD_BUILD) used both; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/workflow-env$ passes and internal/api TestSessionRun (incl. the new [env] case with {run_tmp} and a plain value) passes.
